title: Soundtrack Supremacy II
theme: The 1990s era where R&B movie soundtracks were often bigger, better, and more culturally dominant than traditional studio albums.

toneProgression: Blockbuster movie singles → Specific soundtrack producers and deep cuts → Cassette-only hidden tracks and supergroup credits

vault.note: Digit 4 (index 3) is always visible. Vault code 1-9-9-2 — the year The Bodyguard's soundtrack set the commercial template every major R&B act would follow for a decade. An album marketed as a film tie-in that became the best-selling soundtrack of all time.

questions.question: The Space Jam soundtrack's opening theme — performed by which Miami bass group — became one of the most recognisable sports anthems of the decade?

bonus.bonusHint: DIGIT 2 OF 3 — THE GROUP BEHIND THE SPACE JAM THEME

metadata.fact: The Quad City DJ's — a Miami bass group from Jacksonville, Florida — recorded the 'Space Jam' theme for the 1996 film. The track became one of the most enduring sports arena anthems in American pop culture history. The same group had previously charted with 'C'mon N' Ride It (The Train)' in 1996.
metadata.storyHook: A Miami bass group from Jacksonville wrote the theme for one of the most watched basketball films of the decade. The Quad City DJ's and Space Jam remain inseparable.
metadata.sourceNotes: Discogs entry for Space Jam (Warner Sunset/Atlantic). Official RIAA database.

reserve.question: Lauryn Hill's Grammy-sweeping 1998 solo debut — which won five Grammy Awards including Album of the Year — was released on which record label?

metadata.fact: 'The Miseducation of Lauryn Hill' was released on Ruffhouse Records — a subsidiary of Columbia Records — on August 25, 1998. Ruffhouse was the label home of The Fugees, through which Lauryn Hill had already established her commercial credentials. The album sold over 420,000 copies in its first week and went on to win five Grammy Awards in 1999.
metadata.storyHook: Ruffhouse Records released 'The Miseducation of Lauryn Hill' and changed the conversation about what an R&B solo debut could be. Five Grammys later, the label's place in history was secure.
metadata.sourceNotes: IMDB Soundtracks database. Official CD liner notes for Love Jones (Columbia).
